items.text: Integrating Amazon With Business Central Across Two Storefronts

Folio3 rebuilt a multi-storefront Amazon seller's Amazon-to-Business Central integration on the Burq connector, syncing orders and items across two Amazon storefronts and clearing a stalled Fulfilled-by-Merchant order backlog.
TALK TO AN INTEGRATION EXPERT
2 Amazon Storefronts
Dynamics 365 Business Central
Amazon to Business Central
About The Client
A Multi-Storefront Amazon Seller

The client sells through two separate Amazon storefronts, a primary Amazon-Business Central store and an Amazon Business Central specialty store, and runs Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC) as its ERP. They needed Amazon order and item data to flow reliably into Business Central so that both storefronts stayed in sync.
Challenges Faced

The client's Amazon-to-Business Central integration had stalled. A change of delivery partner mid-project, together with Fulfilled-by-Merchant orders that were not processing in the live environment, was holding up order fulfilment across both storefronts.
FIX A STALLED INTEGRATION
A mid-project change of integration partner disrupted the Amazon-to-Business Central rollout
Fulfilled-by-Merchant (FBM) orders were not appearing or processing in the live Business Central environment
Previous providers could not deliver the integration within the client's restricted environment
What The Client Needed
With order fulfilment on hold, the client needed a partner who could take over the transition and finish the integration inside their existing environment.
One reliable integration partner
A single team to take over the transition and complete the Amazon-to-Business Central integration cleanly.
FBM orders flowing into Business Central
Fulfilled-by-Merchant orders processed correctly on live customer orders and synced through to Business Central.
Both Amazon storefronts kept in sync
Consistent order and item data across the Amazon-Business Central store and the specialty store.
Our Solution
One Connector For Every Amazon and Business Central Sync

Folio3 built a custom integration on the Burq connector, which reads Amazon's complex JSON files, passes the data into Business Central, and fetches information back from Amazon to keep both systems in sync. Folio3 provided 100% of the input and proposed the Amazon-to-Business Central approach as the optimal solution.
Burq connector for Amazon and Business Central
One connector establishes and manages the connection between Amazon and Business Central, replacing the stalled setup left by the previous partner.
Complex Amazon JSON parsed into Business Central
The connector reads Amazon's complex JSON files and writes the order data straight into Business Central, with no manual re-keying.
FBM orders processed on live customer orders
The FBM job now runs correctly on customer orders, so Fulfilled-by-Merchant orders synchronize and process in the live environment.
Specialty store priced from Business Central
For the specialty store, each order shows the item price set in Business Central rather than the Amazon order price, keeping pricing aligned with BC.
One-stop, ERP-agnostic integration platform
The same platform can connect any Microsoft ERP with any eCommerce channel, so the client can add more connections as the business grows.
REQUEST A CALL
Business Outcomes
With the integration rebuilt on the Burq connector, the client's Amazon and Business Central data now stays in sync, and the platform gives them room to grow.
Both Amazon storefronts synced with Business Central
Order and item data flows reliably between Amazon and Business Central across the primary and specialty stores.
FBM order backlog cleared
Fulfilled-by-Merchant orders are processed on live customer orders and no longer stall fulfilment.
Delivered in a restricted environment
Folio3 completed the integration where previous providers could not, working within the client's restricted environment.
Room to add more connections
The client can now establish multiple ERP and eCommerce connections from one platform as needs change.
Analysis on synchronized data
With Amazon and Business Central data unified, the team can run analysis on a single, consistent dataset.
